content.title: COP31 Talks Fail as EU Rejects Fossil Fuel Phase-Out
content.caption: COP31 talks in Antalya, Turkey, fail to achieve consensus on climate action, with the EU rejecting any language on a fossil fuel phase-out.

slides.heading: COP31 Talks Fail as EU Rejects Fossil Fuel Phase-Out
slides.text: COP31 talks in Antalya, Turkey, fail to achieve consensus on climate action, with the EU rejecting any language on a fossil fuel phase-out.

slides.heading: EU Rejects Fossil Fuel Phase-Out
slides.text: The European Union (EU) rejects any language on a fossil fuel phase-out, leading to a failure in the COP31 talks in Antalya, Turkey.

slides.heading: Impact on Climate Action
slides.text: The failure to include any explicit language on a fossil fuel phase-out impacts the ability to achieve a consensus on future climate action.
